title: The review becomes a data system
technology: survey evidence, external validation and the announced AW27 AI pilot
governingQuestion: Can software scale a judgment system without disguising its boundaries?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews, specialist review and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The review becomes a data system
longform.opening: The next screening layer has been announced: an AI-supported pilot for AW27, still led by human review.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: The current framework uses submitted survey responses and documentation, reviewed by an external committee led by Rambøll.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: CPHFW and Renoon announced an AI-supported screening pilot for AW27 after a year of testing; human-led screening is stated to continue.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: Public materials do not yet provide the pilot model card, training data, error rates, appeal path, energy measurement or independent bias evaluation.

longform.closing: Copenhagen’s distinction is not a claim of purity. It is the decision to make participation depend on evidence—and the obligation to keep asking what that evidence cannot establish.
